notes.title: Version 1.03
notes.content:
[list]
[*]Score and settings summary screen show at end of song
[*]Fixed some typos
[*]Added some more controller support
[*]VSync saved setting loads correctly on startup
[/list]

Including Changes from 1.02 Testing Branch:
[list]
[*]Game over and quitting does not unlock achievements anymore.
[*]Added a delay to objects spawning at start of song.
[*]Added a 1 minute minimum song length for achievements.
[*]Video and settings menu should now close when pressing "B" button on controller.
[*]Added more checks for the 100% Achievement unlock. (After Supernova Unlock)
[*]Song name doesn't disappear after playing a song.
[*]Added some more info to explain wormhole length setting. It doesn’t cut wormholes shorter.
[*]Demo achievement unlocks after playing a demo song.
[/list]

notes.title: Test Version 1.02
notes.content:
You can opt-in and test version 1.02.

Right-click item of the game in the steam library.
Choose properties
Navigate to BETAS tab
Choose the testing branch

Changes:
[list]
[*]Game over and quitting does not unlock achievements anymore.
[*]Added a delay to objects spawning at start of song.
[*]Added a 1 minute minimum song length for achievements.
[*]Video and settings menu should now close when pressing "B" button on controller.
[*]Added more checks for the 100% Achievement unlock. (After Supernova Unlock)
[*]Song name doesn't disappear after playing a song.
[*]Added some more info to explain wormhole length setting. It doesn’t cut wormholes shorter.
[*]Demo achievement unlocks after playing a demo song.
[/list]

Special thanks to luckz and Ryuu for all your feedback!
